about.heading: About
about.bio: I'm a bilingual marketing professional with a passion for transforming brands through strategic creativity and innovative design. Currently pursuing a degree in Business Administration at Universidad de Palermo while building my professional portfolio in brand management and digital marketing. With expertise spanning visual design, social media strategy, and event planning, I thrive at the intersection of creativity and business objectives. I'm known for my proactive approach, positive attitude, and ability to adapt to fast-paced environments while maintaining a strong focus on delivering measurable results.
